# partiteai_mcp_connection_subscription (Data Source)

One subscription of a tunnel MCP connection, with the keys issued for it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Subscription identifier
- `mcp_connection_id` (String) The tunnel connection this subscription belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `criteria` (Attributes Set) Tags a conversation must carry for this subscription to serve it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--criteria))
- `name` (String) Names the subscription within its connection.
- `tunnel_keys` (Attributes List) Credentials issued for this subscription. The credential itself is readable only when a key is created, so it is not here. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tunnel_keys))
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--criteria"></a>
### Nested Schema for `criteria`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String)
- `value` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--tunnel_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tunnel_keys`

Read-Only:

- `attached` (Boolean) False until a subscription has taken the key.
- `created_at` (String)
- `expires_at` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `label` (String)
- `revoked_at` (String)
